title: Covenant of the League of Nations, Article 10: members undertake to preserve territorial integrity
summary: The Avalon Project text says members undertake to respect and preserve, against external aggression, the territorial integrity and existing political independence of all members. The Council advises on the means.
body: The Avalon Project's text of the Covenant of the League of Nations, opened 2026-11-18, gives Article 10: 'The Members of the League undertake to respect and preserve as against external aggression the territorial integrity and existing political independence of all Members of the League. In case of any such aggression or in case of any threat or danger of such aggression the Council shall advise upon the means by which this obligation shall be fulfilled.' Article 11, on the same text, says any war or threat of war, whether immediately affecting any of the members or not, is declared a matter of concern to the whole League, and the League shall take any action that may be deemed wise and effectual to safeguard the peace of nations. In such an emergency the Secretary General shall, on the request of any member, forthwith summon a meeting of the Council. Article 10's verb for the Council is 'advise'. Article 11's verb for the League is 'take any action that may be deemed wise and effectual'. They are different sentences.

sources.title: The Covenant of the League of Nations
sources.author: Avalon Project, Yale Law School

said_by: Covenant of the League of Nations
